routes.description: Enable MockDeviceKit, so the app's SDK talks to simulated glasses. Has no effect while it is already enabled: call mock_disable first to apply a different configuration. Verify with mock_is_enabled.

initiallyRegistered.description: Start registered with Meta AI. Defaults to true; pass false to exercise the registration flow.

initialPermissionsGranted.description: Start with every permission granted when registered. Defaults to true; pass false to exercise the permission flow.

routes.description: Disable MockDeviceKit: unpairs every mock device and restores the real SDK providers. The test server keeps running, so mock_enable works afterwards. Verify with mock_is_enabled.
Return whether MockDeviceKit is enabled: {status, isEnabled}.
Return the ids of the paired mock devices: {status, pairedDevices}. Use this to verify the effect of pair/unpair (pairedDevices should include the deviceId mock_pair_device returned).

Pair a mock glasses device. It starts powered off, folded, and not worn: call mock_power_on, then mock_don (which also unfolds) before the app can use it. Returns {status, deviceId}. Verify with mock_device_state: pairedDevices should include the returned deviceId.

model.description: Glasses model to simulate, by its `GlassesModel` case name. Defaults to 'rayBanMeta'; pass 'metaRayBanDisplay' for a display-capable device.

routes.description: Unpair a mock device. Verify with mock_device_state (the device leaves pairedDevices).
Power the mock device on.
Power the mock device off (ends the active session).
Simulate putting the mock glasses on.
Simulate taking the mock glasses off.
Fold the mock glasses (ends the active session).
Unfold the mock glasses.
Set the battery level the mock device reports, from 0 to 100. The app reads it from the device's metadata; verify it in the app's battery UI.
Set whether the mock device reports that it is charging. The app reads it from the device's metadata.
Set the thermal level the mock device reports, to exercise the app's handling of a hot device. The app reads it from the device's metadata.

level.description: The thermal level to report, from 'none' (normal) to 'emergency'.

routes.description: Single-tap the cap-touch sensor; toggles the active session between paused and running.
Tap-and-hold the cap-touch sensor; stops the active session.
Set the mock camera video feed to a resource bundled in the target app. After the app starts a stream, the mocked video plays as the camera feed.

resourceName.description: Bundle resource name (e.g. 'plant'). Must be bundled in the target app.

routes.description: Set the mock still image returned for Stream.capturePhoto, from a bundled resource. A phone-camera feed set by mock_set_camera_facing takes precedence. Camera.photo ignores this image: use mock_set_captured_photo.

resourceName.description: Bundle resource name (e.g. 'plant'). Must be bundled in the target app.

source.description: The surface the event should appear to come from. Defaults to 'captouch'.
The surface the event should appear to come from. Defaults to 'captouch'.
The surface the event should appear to come from. Defaults to 'captouch'.
The surface the event should appear to come from. Defaults to 'captouch'.

routes.description: Inject a select / confirm event. Delivered only while the app has an Inputs session streaming.

source.description: The surface the event should appear to come from. Defaults to 'captouch'.

routes.description: Inject a back / dismiss event. Delivered only while the app has an Inputs session streaming.

source.description: The surface the event should appear to come from. Defaults to 'captouch'.

routes.description: Press the glasses capture button. Delivered only while the app has an Inputs session streaming.

pressType.description: The gesture to simulate. 'shortPress' (the default) typically takes a photo, 'hold' starts a video, 'doublePress' stops one.

routes.description: Inject a press of the glasses action button. Delivered only while the app has an Inputs session streaming.

type.description: Which button to press. Defaults to 'action', the only button.

routes.description: Inject one sample of a Neural Band drag. Deliver a full drag as action='down', then any number of 'move' samples, then 'up'.

action.description: The phase of the drag this sample represents.

dx.description: Change in x since the previous sample.

dy.description: Change in y since the previous sample.

routes.description: Set the mock IMU stream to a CSV recording bundled in the target app, for deterministic replay. Columns, in order: timestampNs, accel XYZ (m/s²), gyro XYZ (rad/s), mag XYZ (µT), orientation WXYZ. May be set before or during a Motion session.

resourceName.description: Bundle resource name (e.g. 'plant'). Must be bundled in the target app.

routes.description: Deliver a transcription result to the app. Delivered only while the app has a Speech session listening; otherwise it is dropped.

isFinal.description: Whether this closes the utterance. Defaults to true; pass false to deliver a partial result.

routes.description: Deliver a terminal recognition error, ending the Speech session. Use this to exercise the app's error handling.

errorCode.description: A raw android.speech.SpeechRecognizer code, not the SDK's SpeechError (e.g. 7 for no-match).

routes.description: Complete the active Speech session normally, as the device does when the user stops talking.
Set the locale the mock reports for the next Speech session. Has no effect on a session already in progress.

Choose where the next Speech session's transcriptions come from: 'injected' (the default) delivers only what mock_speech_transcribe sends; 'liveDeviceAsr' transcribes the host's microphone with the platform recognizer and needs microphone and speech-recognition permission. Ignored while a session is listening.

While enabled, the glasses report an old Device Access Toolkit app version, so the app's next session start surfaces the app-on-the-glasses update-required error. Disable to report a supported version again. Lasts until changed or the device is unpaired.

While enabled, the glasses report firmware below the SDK's minimum, so the app's session start fails with update required. Takes effect when the glasses next connect: call it before mock_power_on. Disable to report supported firmware again. Lasts until changed or the device is unpaired.

Set the photo the mock device returns for Camera.photo captures, from a JPEG or HEIC resource bundled in the target app. Set this before the app captures; without it the device reports no capture is available. Stream.capturePhoto ignores it: use mock_set_captured_image.

resourceName.description: Bundle resource name (e.g. 'plant'). Must be bundled in the target app.

routes.description: Arm a single capture failure: the next Camera.photo capture responds with an error instead of an image, then the flag clears. Stream.capturePhoto ignores it.

Stream the mock camera feed from one of the phone's physical cameras instead of a bundled file. Clears any file feed set by mock_set_camera_feed. A simulator has no camera, so this is for physical devices.
Set the status the mock reports when the app checks a wearable permission. Use this to drive the app's permission-denied path.

status.description: The status to report for it.

routes.description: Set the result the mock returns when the app *requests* a wearable permission, rather than merely checks it.

result.description: The status to report for it.

routes.description: Whether any app is connected to the device's voice-invocation service, i.e. would receive mock_voice_launch_app. Returns {status, hasConnectedApps}.
Whether the app has a Speech session listening on the device, i.e. whether mock_speech_transcribe would be delivered. Returns {status, isListening}.

Why the live speech source (mock_speech_set_transcription_source 'liveDeviceAsr') is not transcribing, e.g. a missing permission, or null when it is fine or not in use. Returns {status, liveSourceDiagnostic}.
Whether the app is streaming motion (IMU) samples from the device. Returns {status, isStreaming}.

Trigger a Hey Meta launch-app voice invocation, as if the user had spoken a command to open the app. Returns the requestId of the delivered action; a null requestId means no app was listening, so nothing was delivered.
Deliver a deliberately malformed Hey Meta action, to check the app surfaces the error instead of acting on a bogus invocation. Returns the requestId; a null requestId means no app was listening.

afterRevision.description: Pass the revision from a previous call to poll for a change; the reply is {unchanged: true} while the content still matches it.

routes.description: Tap an element on the simulated glasses display, as the user would on real glasses. Identifiers are content-derived and change on every redraw: take a fresh one from mock_display_content's tree each time. Fails with a conflict when no display session is active; ok means delivered, not matched.
Report a video playback event from the simulated glasses display, as the on-glass player would while showing a video the app sent.
